title: REMOVE QUARTER WINDOW GLASS / INSTALLATION OF QUARTER WINDOW GLASS

content.description: Illustration showing quarter window glass with arrows pointing to glass retainers and screws locations

items: (c) Push piano wire through from the interior.
(d) Tie both wire ends to a wooden block.
(e) Separate the glass by pulling the piano wire around it. Remove the glass.

rows:

Dam

content.description: Two illustrations showing hands wiping/cleaning the quarter window glass and body area with cloth

content.text: Wipe off any adhesive left on body and glass with alcohol or unleaded gasoline.
